complete_examples.text: Consider a nonlinear stochastic oscillator which is excited by both additive and multiplicative Gaussian white noises as follows ̈X+ h1(X, ̇X, t) = ξ1(t) + h2(X, ̇X, t)ξ2(t), (1) where Xand ̇Xrepresent the displacement and velocity of the nonlinear system, respectively.

Compared with the existing EPC method, which targets on stationary probabilistic solutions, the presented approach extends the previous method and aims to obtain the non-stationary nonzero mean probabilistic solutions of nonlinear stochastic oscillator, in which the nonlinear ordinary differential equations are formulated and solved.
